meta.provenance_note: Read directly from the PDF via PyMuPDF on 2026-09-19 — extraction is clean (this book is in English). Same source and treatment as iqra_curriculum_g2_english_sem1.json: unit titles, page numbers, vocabulary, grammar phrases, and listening skill descriptors taken from the book's own two-page 'Scope and sequence' table (pp. 4-5); the Speaking/Reading/Writing/Project/Viewing columns were not used. Each numbered unit is split into two lessons — Vocabulary & Grammar, and Listening & Speaking. Units are numbered 5-8, continuing Semester 1's own numbering. The Welcome unit here is a review of Semester 1's vocabulary, so its table cell lists only category labels (e.g. 'Inside toys', 'Family') rather than individual words — `vocabulary` is left empty for it rather than re-listing Semester 1's word lists.
known_gaps: This is real content (vocabulary lists, grammar phrases, listening skill descriptors), not title-only — but it is unit-level, not lesson-level: each unit's actual internal lesson count and exact per-page lesson titles were not verified page by page.

Following the established English-subject precedent, `main_idea_ar` and `objectives` hold literal English text (this book's own language), not Arabic; `title_ar` carries a plain Arabic gloss of the English title for search/display.

Phonics letter/word-family lists printed inside the table's Vocabulary column are excluded from `vocabulary` — they are letter-sound drill items, not thematic vocabulary, and this schema has no separate field for them.

The Welcome unit's Vocabulary cell lists category labels only (a review unit, not new words), so u0_l1's `vocabulary` array is empty — a genuine content difference from every other lesson in this book, not an extraction gap.
